title: LCARdS Select Menu Card Configuration
description: Renders an input_select entity as a grid of LCARS-styled option buttons. Each button calls input_select.select_option when tapped. The selected option is styled as "active", all others as "inactive".

data_sources.description: Data sources for real-time entity tracking, historical data, and processing pipelines. Each key defines a named data source accessible in templates.
data_sources.$comment: Data sources enable entity subscriptions, history preload, and unified processing pipeline

attribute.description: Entity attribute to track instead of state

enum_mapping.description: Map non-numeric states to numbers so they can be plotted or processed (on/off map to 1/0 automatically)

hours.description: Hours of history to preload (1-168, default: 6)

processing.description: Processing pipeline with named processors. Each processor transforms data and stores results in a buffer accessible via templates.

input_source.description: Name of another processor in this pipeline whose output this one reads (creates a dependency chain). If omitted, uses the raw entity value.

enabled.description: Set false to pass values through unchanged (default true)

from.description: convert_unit: source unit (e.g. c, f, w, kw). Not a chaining key: use input_source.

method.description: smooth: exponential | moving_average | gaussian. round: round | floor | ceil

alpha.description: smooth (exponential): weight of the newest value, 0 to 1 (default 0.3)

window.description: smooth: sample count (default 10). statistics: time window like "5m" or "session"

expression.description: expression: JavaScript expression using value/v, t, sources, entity and Math helpers

sources.description: expression: processor names available as sources[0], sources[1], ...

stats.description: statistics: min, max, mean, median, std_dev, q1, q3, range, count, sum

max_points.description: statistics: keep a time series of this many results

samples.description: trend: samples in the slope window (default 5)

threshold.description: trend: slope below which the trend is stable. threshold: switch point

hysteresis.description: threshold: dead band around the switch point

condition.description: duration: condition like "> 20" that starts the timer

reset_on.description: duration: condition that resets the timer

window_seconds.description: Rolling buffer window: seconds, or a duration like "5m" or "1h". About 10 points per second are kept, at most 1,000 (default 60)

min_emit_ms.description: Minimum ms between updates sent to cards (throttle, default 100)

coalesce_ms.description: Window in ms for merging rapid changes into one update (default: 40% of min_emit_ms, at least 20)

max_delay_ms.description: Longest ms an update may be held back while merging (default: 3 x coalesce_ms)

emit_on_same_value.description: Send updates even when the value did not change (default true)

entity.description: input_select (or select) entity whose options become buttons

id.description: Unique card identifier for rule targeting, animations, and debugging (alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen)

tags.description: Tags for bulk rule targeting and grouping. Allows applying rules to multiple cards at once using tag selectors.

oneOf.description: Card height in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 56 = 56px)

height.description: Card height override. Bare integer = px (e.g. 200 = 200px). CSS units accepted: 200px, 50vh, 10em.

oneOf.description: Card width in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 300 = 300px)

width.description: Card width override. Bare integer = px (e.g. 400 = 400px). CSS units accepted: 400px, 50vw, 10em.

oneOf.description: Minimum card height in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 40 = 40px)
Minimum card height with CSS unit (e.g. 40px, 10vh)

min_height.description: Minimum card height floor. Overrides the --lcards-button-min-height CSS token. Bare integer = px.

oneOf.description: Minimum card width in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 80 = 80px)
Minimum card width with CSS unit (e.g. 80px, 10vw)

min_width.description: Minimum card width floor. Bare integer = px.

oneOf.description: Maximum card height in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 400 = 400px)
Maximum card height with CSS unit (e.g. 400px, 80vh, 20em)

max_height.description: Maximum card height ceiling. Bare integer = px (e.g. 400 = 400px). CSS units accepted: 400px, 80vh, 10em.

oneOf.description: Maximum card width in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 600 = 600px)
Maximum card width with CSS unit (e.g. 600px, 80vw, 20em)

max_width.description: Maximum card width ceiling. Bare integer = px (e.g. 600 = 600px). CSS units accepted: 600px, 80vw, 10em.

overflow.description: CSS overflow shorthand on the card host element (sets both axes unless overridden per-axis).

overflow_x.description: CSS overflow-x on the card host element. Overrides the overflow shorthand for the horizontal axis.

overflow_y.description: CSS overflow-y on the card host element. Overrides the overflow shorthand for the vertical axis.

z_index.description: CSS z-index stacking order on the card host element.

preset.description: Button style preset applied to all option buttons (e.g. lozenge, filled, outline)

grid.description: Grid layout config for option buttons. Supports CSS Grid shorthand or full properties.

columns.description: Number of columns (shorthand → repeat(N, 1fr)) or full CSS grid-template-columns value

rows.description: Number of rows or CSS grid-template-rows value

gap.description: CSS gap shorthand (applies to both row and column gap)

grid-auto-rows.description: CSS grid-auto-rows for implicit row height

height.description: "fit": sizes the card host to the exact height of all buttons (useful for outer grid track sizing). "100%": proportionally fills a bounded parent row, resizing buttons to fit without overflow. For a fixed card height with scrolling, use the top-level height + overflow_y config instead.

oneOf.description: Object form: per-option overrides keyed by option value. Entity order is preserved.

variables.description: Your own named values, available to templates as variables.<name> and {variables.<name>}.

debug_zones.description: Outline every zone on the card (development aid).

value.description: Option value (required in array form, must match entity option)

icon.description: MDI icon (e.g. mdi:home) or Simple Icons (si:github)

style.description: Style overrides for this option (same shape as card-level style)

oneOf.description: Array form: explicit ordered list (also filters which options are shown). Each item must have a "value" key.

variables.description: Your own named values, available to templates as variables.<name> and {variables.<name>}.

debug_zones.description: Outline every zone on the card (development aid).

value.description: Option value (required in array form, must match entity option)

icon.description: MDI icon (e.g. mdi:home) or Simple Icons (si:github)

style.description: Style overrides for this option (same shape as card-level style)

options.description: Per-option configuration. Object: override by name (entity order preserved). Array: explicit order + filter.

style.description: Style applied to all option buttons. Uses the same stateColor schema as lcards-button. active = selected, inactive = unselected.

background.description: Option button background color (state-based or static)

radius.description: Border radius (px or CSS string). Object form for per-corner control.

opacity.description: Base opacity for unselected options (0-1). Defaults to 0.88 if not specified.

tap_action.description: Override the default select_option tap action for ALL option buttons (per-option tap_action takes priority).

service_data.description: Data to pass to the service

navigation_path.description: Path to navigate to (must start with /)

grid_options.description: Home Assistant grid layout options. Controls how many rows and columns this card occupies in the dashboard grid.

oneOf.description: Set to "full" to span all available columns
Number of columns this card spans (1-24)

columns.description: Number of columns (1-24) or "full" to span all columns

rows.description: Number of rows this card spans (1-100)

actionSchema.description: Action to perform on interaction (tap, hold, or double-tap). Supports toggle, service calls, navigation, more-info dialog, or no action.

service_data.description: Data to pass to the service

navigation_path.description: Path to navigate to (must start with /)

lcards_select_menu_options_value_zones.description: Named rectangles (px or *_percent of the card) that text fields and animations can target.

soundsSchema.description: Per-card sound configuration. Overrides global sound settings for this card.

enabled.description: Whether this card fires sounds. Set to false to completely silence this card. Default: true (omit to keep default).

card_tap.description: Asset key for card tap, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

card_hold.description: Asset key for card hold, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

card_double_tap.description: Asset key for card double-tap, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

card_hover.description: Asset key for card hover (desktop), or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

slider_drag_start.description: Asset key for slider grab, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

slider_change.description: Asset key for slider value change, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

slider_drag_end.description: Asset key for slider release, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

toggle_on.description: Asset key for toggle-on, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

toggle_off.description: Asset key for toggle-off, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.
